theme: Light mode prioritized. Clean, sharp, and modern. High-contrast Swiss-inspired layout with stark white backgrounds and precise blue structural accents.

rules: Use 'Outfit' for all headings. DO NOT use Inter for headings.
Use 'Figtree' for body text to maintain a clean, readable UI.
H1 should not exceed text-5xl to text-6xl. Use tracking-tight for all headings.
Overlines and small labels must be uppercase, text-xs, with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Maintain a strict hierarchy; subheading size should be 1-2 Tailwind steps below the heading.
No full-screen gradients. Use pure white or tinted off-white for backgrounds.
Color is function: use Electric Blue (#2540E8) for primary CTAs and active states.
Use Dark Navy (#1E2A78) for massive headings, borders, and heavy structural elements.
Never use pure black or grey. Always tint with the Navy blue hue.

visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp edges. Use `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` maximum to keep the design 'sharp'.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use crisp, solid drop shadows (e.g., `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#1E2A78]`) for interactive elements to appeal to GenZ, or sharp 1px borders (`border-border`) for data-heavy dashboard tables.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use the 'Grid Borders' look for the School Admin Dashboard. Use 'Crystal Glassmorphism' (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-white/20`) for the marketing header.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_page: MODE A: TETRIS GRID. Asymmetrical layouts with generous padding (`p-12` to `p-24`). Use large hero spanning multiple columns.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_saas: MODE B: HIGH DENSITY GRID. Tight gaps (`gap-4`). Use `col-span-1` for KPI cards and `col-span-2` or `col-span-3` for analytics charts.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2x standard padding for containers. Make sure grid items are direct children of the grid.

component_instructions.general: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing sections. Use customized Shadcn components for Dashboard and Wizards.
component_instructions.wizards: For the School Onboarding Wizard, use action-driven checklists and sequence low-friction steps first. Max 3-5 fields per step.
component_instructions.cards: For SaaS, go cardless or use flat rectangular styles with a 1px subtle border. No soft shadows.
component_instructions.tables_and_data: Implement frozen headers and clear status chips for Fee Management.
component_instructions.charts: Use Shadcn charts or Recharts for revenue analytics, fee collection KPIs, and admission funnels. Calibrate data density for Finance/Admin roles.

icons_and_assets.style: Use sharp, consistent stroke widths. Never use emojis as icons.

image_urls.description: Biglyp logo. Place in the sticky navigation bar and footer.
Group of university students. Use in the marketing hero section. Ensure overlay is max `bg-white/40` or `bg-black/30`.
Parent and teen smiling. Use in the feature section targeting the Parent/Student persona.
Modern school building. Use in the campus/school onboarding wizard or admin landing section.

accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA or WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text).
Explicitly set text color on hover states (e.g., `hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white`).
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-btn"`).
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or floating headers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Write React components using `.js` extensions and JavaScript syntax, not `.tsx`.
Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Create depth through layered design elements.
Do NOT apply `transition: all`. Apply transitions to specific properties (e.g., `transition-transform transition-colors`).
Do NOT globally center align the app container in CSS.
Use modern sharp or pill-shaped buttons with interaction micro-animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons.
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than standard `p-4`).
Prioritize existing Shadcn components in `src/components/ui`. Customize them to fit the sharp, GenZ-friendly aesthetic.
